title: ITU Bulletin

questions: Who came, and who sat with them?
What did they say to them, or talk about?
Did anyone phone, or send a photo?
Did they settle, or was it broken?
Any agitation, or things they seemed to see?
Was the unit loud or quiet? Who was with them?
Physio today — passive, or did they help?
Turning, sitting out, eyes opening, a hand squeeze?
Anything today they could not do yesterday?
How long nil by mouth now?
Mouth care, sponges, lip balm — did it help?
Did they seem dry, or ask for a drink?
What has changed since Monday?
Anything taken away — a line, a tube, sedation?
What would they want to know about this week?
Music, radio, a programme on?
Photos or anything brought from home?
Something you learned about who they are.
What did it look like outside today?
Was the unit quieter?
Did they seem to know where they were?

any_day.note: Mouthing, writing, blinking, squeezing — and whether you got there.

standing_note: Write to them, not about them. Explain what was done and why, in plain words. Hard days go in too, without jargon, and say who was there.
